dataflow.name: Nine ways to chart scenario comparisons
dataflow.description: Nine example tables, each charted a different way to compare its scenarios: lines with a band, curves by state, bars with error bars, ensemble strips, grouped bars, stacked bars with totals, donuts, a weighted matrix and a table. In each row a Data Transformation node per scenario keeps its rows, a Compare Scenarios node stacks them, and the chart is the Compare node's own or a Vega-Lite node's after it.
